description: 2026-10-29 startup: Woody could not actuate the desorb tube extraction gas out valve (V20). Ghost blamed the overnight supervisor lock, which had already been cleared at 12:31 UTC. Root cause (Spark): 731e0e8 moved the valve from riser 5 OD7 to OD6; fixed by 9256f09 (restart 13:40 UTC). Messages are Woody's/Indrid's/Vinay's real chat; the final @Ghost question is synthetic.

messages.text: Can someone help me with valve names?  Extraction gas valve out doesn’t seem to open the extraction valve, and there is an extraction vac vent valve and drain valve?
How do I open the extraction valve?
Indrid I have the right valve name and it won’t actuate, is this a supervisor issue?
Spark is adding more valves so it's unclear if the control you're talking about is routed yet
No popup, valve won’t actuate, what else should I look at? It’s not a mechanical issue with the valve, and other valve do actuate
Its a valve we had on the old system.  It is one that got moved, since they replaced the filter.
But it must have been working yesterday. Did things change last night?
@Ghost why won't the desorb tube extraction gas out valve actuate?

ground_truth: 731e0e8 (Spark, Oct 28, live since the 21:03 UTC restart) moved desorb_tube_extraction_gas_out_valve from panel riser 5 OD7 (manifold 1 pin 16) to OD6 (manifold 1 pin 15, previously a spare coil). The valve is still wired to pin 16, so commands energise the spare coil; telemetry readback follows the command because it reads OD6 too. The supervisor lock was cleared at 12:31 UTC and is not involved. Fix: 9256f09 back to OD7.

must_mention.name: lock not the cause / already cleared
